why: Satisfying growth transformations (seed to tree, egg to chick) are loved by all ages, safe for any audience, and get a strong rewatch rate.

series.name: Glow Up: Nature
series.style: beautiful nature macro photography, soft natural light, the same spot and same camera angle in every stage, vertical 9:16 frame
series.negative: text, letters, words, watermark, logo, real people, celebrities, blood, blurry, distorted, painting, illustration, cartoon, CGI render, smudged faces, melted people, warped architecture, oversaturated colours
rules: One living thing per reel, growing step by step in the same place.
Labels are stages (e.g. Seed, Sprout, Tree) or simple times (Day 1, Week 6). Only real, well-known stages.
Gentle and beautiful; no animals hurt.

topics: A mango seed growing into a mango tree with fruit
An egg hatching into a chick and growing into a hen
A lion cub growing into a lion
A kitten growing into a cat
A rose bud opening into a full rose
A foal growing into a horse
A baby sea turtle growing into a big sea turtle
A sunflower from seed to full bloom
